items.title: Cigna Shares Rise as Third-Quarter Earnings Beat Estimates and 2026 Profit Outlook Increases
items.summary: Cigna Group (NYSE:CI) shares gained 1. 5% in premarket trading on Thursday after the US health insurer reported third-quarter earnings and revenue above analysts’ expectations and raised its adjusted earnings guidance for 2026.

items.title: Cigna shares climb on raised earnings outlook, Q3 beat
items.summary: Investing.com -- Cigna shares climbed 1.5% in premarket trading Thursday after the health insurer beat third-quarter profit and revenue estimates and raised its full-year earnings outlook.

items.title: Cigna (NYSE:CI) beats Q3 2026 sales expectations
items.summary: Health insurance company Cigna (NYSE:CI) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q3 2026, with revenue up 6.1% year on year to $73.79 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $7.98 per share was 6.3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Cigna Group Lifts Outlook as Revenue Climbs
items.summary: The healthcare company reported a third-quarter profit of $1.44 billion, or $5.47 a share, compared with $1.87 billion, or $6.98 a share, a year earlier.

items.title: Cigna (CI) Q3 Earnings and Revenues Beat Estimates
items.summary: Cigna (CI) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +6.97% and +0.35%, respectively, for the quarter ended September 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
